pro_course_detail.title: Learn English | For Very Young & Young Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Class Description for Young Learners (Ages 3-12)

Our English classes for young learners (ages 3-12) create a fun, engaging, and supportive environment where children can build a strong foundation in English. Designed to suit the developmental needs of each age group, our program combines songs, stories, games, and hands-on activities to make language learning enjoyable and effective.

For very young learners (ages 3-5), classes focus on playful, sensory-based activities. We use songs, storytelling, movement, and colorful visuals to introduce basic vocabulary and simple phrases, helping children feel comfortable with English in a warm, interactive setting.

For early learners (ages 6-8), we introduce more vocabulary, phonics, and basic sentence structures. Through role-play and real-life scenarios, students learn phrases they can use in everyday situations. Activities such as games and interactive storytelling encourage speaking and listening, building their confidence as they use English independently.

For older learners (ages 9-12), we build on the basics with more complex vocabulary, reading and writing skills, and conversational English. We explore topics relevant to their age group, such as hobbies, school, and friendships, to keep them motivated and engaged. Structured games, group activities, and mini-projects help develop their communication skills while fostering teamwork and creativity.

Each lesson is filled with positive reinforcement and designed to match each child's language development stage, encouraging a love for English and a sense of achievement. We aim to help students leave each class confident, curious, and eager to continue their English journey.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn English | For Teens
pro_course_detail.description:
Our English classes for teenagers provide a dynamic and engaging environment where students build strong language skills through relevant and practical topics. Tailored to meet the unique needs of teens, the program focuses on real-world communication, academic readiness, and creative expression, helping students confidently use English in diverse settings.

Classes cover all language skills—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—with an emphasis on interactive activities, debates, and project-based learning. We explore topics that resonate with teens, such as current events, social media, future goals, and global cultures. Through these discussions, students learn to express their ideas clearly, respond thoughtfully, and engage in meaningful dialogues, building both fluency and critical thinking skills.

Our lessons incorporate multimedia, role-play, and group projects, allowing students to practice English in various contexts. Writing assignments may include essays, creative writing, or opinion pieces, enhancing their ability to communicate effectively in both formal and informal styles. For speaking, activities like presentations, group discussions, and debates encourage students to articulate their opinions confidently while learning to listen and respond respectfully to others.

Grammar and vocabulary are taught in context, reinforcing their use in real conversations. By focusing on language that teens encounter in academic, social, and online settings, we ensure that learning is relevant and immediately applicable.

Each class creates a supportive space for teens to explore language, share perspectives, and build skills they can apply in future studies, careers, and everyday life. With guidance and encouragement, students leave each session more confident, self-assured, and motivated to advance their English skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Português para crianças
pro_course_detail.description:
Nossas aulas de português para crianças de 3 a 12 anos foram pensadas para oferecer um ambiente divertido e acolhedor, onde os pequenos podem desenvolver suas habilidades no idioma de forma natural e prazerosa. A metodologia é adaptada para cada faixa etária e combina histórias, músicas, jogos e atividades práticas para tornar o aprendizado do português uma experiência positiva.

Para os alunos mais novos (3 a 5 anos), as aulas são interativas e envolvem muito movimento, música e brincadeiras, despertando o interesse pelo idioma de forma lúdica. Com foco no desenvolvimento sensorial e na introdução de vocabulário básico, as atividades ajudam as crianças a se familiarizarem com o português e a se sentirem confortáveis ao usá-lo.

Para as crianças de 6 a 8 anos, o programa inclui um vocabulário mais amplo e frases simples. Usamos jogos e dramatizações para estimular a comunicação e melhorar as habilidades de escuta e fala. As crianças aprendem novas palavras e expressões que podem usar no dia a dia, ganhando confiança para se expressarem em português.

Já para os alunos de 9 a 12 anos, as aulas aprofundam o vocabulário e introduzem a leitura e a escrita de forma mais estruturada. O programa é voltado para o desenvolvimento das quatro habilidades principais—leitura, escrita, escuta e fala—por meio de atividades interativas e temas de interesse dos adolescentes, como redes sociais, atualidades, cultura e projetos futuros. Essas discussões incentivam os alunos a expressarem suas opiniões, argumentarem e participarem de conversas significativas, aumentando a confiança e a fluência no uso do português.

Para aprimorar a escrita, trabalhamos com textos variados, incluindo redações, artigos de opinião, e produções criativas. Nosso objetivo é criar um espaço seguro e acolhedor, onde os adolescentes possam desenvolver o domínio do português de forma espontânea, crítica e aplicada, preparando-se para os desafios da vida acadêmica e pessoal.

pro_course_detail.description:
We'll work on three IELTS speaking tasks:
1) IELTS Speaking part 1 lasts between 4-5 minutes, includes around 8-10 IELTS speaking questions, and about 2-3 familiar IELTS speaking topics such as your job, your studies, your family, your hometown, your accommodation, etc.
2) You'll talk about a particular IELTS speaking topic. The topic is selected for you and will be given to you on a card (Candidate Task Card). You will then have 1 minute to prepare your answer and then a maximum of 2 minutes to speak. 
3) You'll be asked about 4-8 more IELTS speaking questions which are connected to the IELTS speaking topics discussed in part 2. The examiner will also ask you a few questions based on your answers, so the entire part 3 is a two-way discussion with the examiner and will last 4 - 5 minutes.

teacher_info.intro: I am a professional online English/ASL teacher with TEFL/TESOL certification, and I specialize in General English. I have also been teaching American sign language for over 10 years, and have experience with signers at all levels.
teacher_info.introduction: I am a Belizean national, and even though the country has many different languages I grew up in an English speaking home with English speaking parents, the schools I attended were all in English, we were taught the English grammar there aswell as how to read write and speak English properly. At the age of 8 I was enrolled in another school that specialized in public speaking, this taught me many aditional skills like how to read accurately, correct pronounciation, gestures, naturalness, poise, proper sense stress etc. In this school I also learned how to develop ability as a teacher, and so by the age of 19 I was able to conduct classes on my own. At age 11 I started learning a new language that was American sign language, I have many deaf friends and I wanted to communicate with them better, so today 12 years later I find myself volunteering to help people learn ASL from the very basic to deep and technical terms. To accomplish my goals as a teacher/tutor I use a lot of visual aids and this has proven to be effective for any language, videos, pictures, even a white board and sharpie at times are part of my arsenal of tools to teach language. Along with this I keep my class room fun and motivated, growing up with a house full of brothers I learned that I don't always get what i want right away and later in life I realized that this caused me to develop a great deal of patience in whatever I do, even my wife admires my patience. I have a variety of books ranging from pre-k to advance levels, I like to talk to my student first and get a feel for them and their level of English then using the material out of an appropriate book I develop some worksheets for them. Some material that I work with are "Let's go" "Side by Side" "Teen Talk""Wonders serie's" just to name a few. With children I like to use more objects and pictures to teach and with teens and adults or advance students I use more worksheets and focus more on refining accents and linguistics.
